background.retainedAs: Read-only shared syntax models; no background EditorView

measurementBoundaries.input: Trusted beforeinput capture to next requestAnimationFrame callback; not final pixels, layout completion, or presentation timestamp.
measurementBoundaries.checkbox: Trusted pointerup capture or keyboard click capture to next requestAnimationFrame callback; completion text must have committed.
measurementBoundaries.dispatch: Elapsed synchronous execution of the actual EditorView.dispatch public method when its document changes; includes synchronous DOM updates, excludes later layout and paint.
measurementBoundaries.aggregation: First 20 visible-page trusted events with a document change observed before their next rAF. P95 is nearest-rank ceil(0.95*N). Raw excluded samples are retained.
measurementBoundaries.nativeEventTiming: Auxiliary only: requested durationThreshold=16ms, duration is quantized to 8ms. Missing entries are not zero and cannot establish a sub-16ms percentile.
measurementBoundaries.instrumentation: The JSON report textarea is frozen while sampling. Only compact counters update after measured frames; full serialization happens after sampling stops.
measurementBoundaries.automation: This page never generates keyboard or pointer input. Script-dispatched untrusted events are reported separately and never included in trusted percentiles.

validationNote: 生产构建，固定 20 项目（当前 5000 任务），真实字母键输入与 Space 激活复选框各 20 次；报告文本框在采样期间冻结。输入到下一 rAF P95 为 12.6ms，键盘完成到下一 rAF P95 为 31.7ms。下一 rAF 不等于最终像素呈现；此处不是 Tauri 冷启动或 WebView2 屏幕时延验收。
